text:
Anya: Async: pulling a quick status for Q2 OKR milestone 'Autoscale + Dedicated rollout' — need a one-paragraph for execs by 5pm. What shipped, what slipped, blockers, owners?

Priya: Shipped: canary for dedicated pool scaling (us-west) to 10 customers; initial autoscale signal and metrics dashboards wired. Docs PR merged: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/987

Tom: Slipped: kernel-path optimizer regression rolled in during last rollout; perf dropped ~12% at p95. Root cause identified, fix in PR #432 (https://github.com/redwood/rt-runtime/pull/432). Need infra to kick off CI with repro load.

Ravi: I'll run the CI repro today — queueing load test. Est ETA for CI runs ~120m. Also note we need a config toggle to rollback quantization profile if needed.

Ken: I'm owner for the rollback toggle — adding a feature flag: `autoscale.rollback_quant_profile` in config. Will create PR and ping for review.

Lina: Ownership ask: who owns enabling Dedicated for customer ACME? We had a permission hoop in onboarding that blocked enabling in their account last week.

Priya: I own ACME onboarding; blocked on infra IAM change (ticket #2456). Patch submitted.

Anya: Can we agree on owners+next steps: Tom fixes PR urgency P0, Ken ships flag PR, Ravi runs CI repro, Priya completes IAM change. Target re-roll by tomorrow morning and canary to 20%.

Tom: I'll prioritize the PR today — ETA 3pm PT. @Ken please leave the review so I can merge.

Ken: On it — will review by 2:45pm. FYI left inline comments about test coverage.

Priya: IAM patch staged; onboarding team will verify ACME tomorrow morning. Marking dependent: ACME dedicated enable.

Anya: Also code review pings: @eng-platform, @eng-sre — please sanity-check rollback flag and canary policy. Short checklist: (1) merge PRs (2) run CI repro (3) canary to 20% (4) monitor cost/latency dashboards.

ops-bot: canary deployment to us-west started at 13:02 PT. Monitoring hooks active.

Ravi: CI repro started 13:10 PT. Will post results in this thread. If perf improves with revert, we fall back.

Tom: PR merged at 14:05 PT — rolling patch. Thanks @Ken for the quick review.

ops-bot: canary rollout to 20% at 14:20 PT. No errors so far. p95 latency +2%.

Lina: Noted. I'll update milestone tracker. Anyone want to add a one-line note for execs about risk and mitigation?

Priya: one-liner: 'Canary extended to 20%; observed marginal p95 increase; rollback flag ready; full rollout delayed until post-qa.'

Anya: Perfect. I'll assemble one-paragraph and post in weekly exec thread by 17:00. Thanks all — ping here if anything changes. :thumbsup:
